title: Książ Lion Gate at Świebodzice
visualBrief: Pale sandstone piers with shield-bearing lions, curved terracotta wall panels, urn-topped outer posts and open wrought-iron leaves.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: +Z into the park. The paired lion shields turn inward and toward the town junction to the north, along −Z.
nativeAxes.origin: Mapped passage center. Y0 is the Terrarium elevation sampled at the gate node.

sourceFacts.primaryDescription: Independent Brama Lwów heritage gate node and adjoining path. Irena Goderska’s park-side photograph and the linked restored views establish the profile, materials and signed approach.

reconstruction.basis: Own mapped Brama Lwów node and adjacent path controls; original medium-fi exterior from a 2012 photograph.
reconstruction.scope: One of three park gates in ksiaz_castle_and_park_complex; other site groups remain incomplete.
reconstruction.registration: The park-side photograph looks through the gate toward the mapped Wałbrzyska and Kasztanowa junction. The road-side photograph confirms the opposite approach and inward-facing lions. Foundations and wall plinths follow retained terrain, and the open leaves sit beside the path.

Map data locates the opening and adjoining path only. Widths, heights and wing-wall curves are photographic estimates.
The restored exterior follows photographs from both approaches. The iron leaves are shown open.
Seated lions, manes, paws, shields and tails are original simplified medium-fi forms without facial likeness, carved heraldry or sculptural microdetail.
